name: Deep-Eye
clergy: the Deepwatch, who guard the innermost groves where no stranger walks and the old song sleeps
attitude_to_magic: The Glimmer wakens the forest; Deep-Eye sleeps beneath it. To wake him is to court the old war.

worship_by_species.name: Deep-Eye
worship_by_species.note: Crownlands hunters tell children that wandering into the deep grove without a Guide is to invite the silence.

worship_by_species.name: the-Ancient-Keep
worship_by_species.note: The deep-folk agree: the places where the old song sleeps are not to be broken, for the mountain below knows.

worship_by_species.name: Deep-Eye
worship_by_species.note: The greenfolk name no other guardian of the grove's heart; they leave offerings of silence at the grove-edge.

worship_by_species.name: the-Silent-One
worship_by_species.note: The desert's silence is his domain; the Rememberers say he is the reason the old tongue must not be spoken aloud.
